testcase.name: another tenant cannot refresh or read a schema and learns nothing()
samples are masked before they are stored even when the connector forgot()
masking is total bounded and idempotent()
personal secret and identifier columns are masked by name()
the ai view has no sensitive column value at all and no metadata()
a second refresh bumps the version reports the diff and is rate limited()
the fingerprint covers structure but not samples or order()
refresh stores a versioned snapshot and with no samples requested no sample exists anywhere()
uuid style identifiers stay readable and ordinary words are untouched()
discovery needs its permission and samples need a second one()
sensitive values are caught by their shape even in an innocent column()
